```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
```

## Results Overview

Below are the statewide vote totals for candidates in the 2026 Democratic primary election for Governor, aggregated across Florida's 67 counties.

```{r}
#| label: plot-democratic-governor-primary

# Locate all county result files
files <- list.files("data", pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

# Read tab-delimited files and filter for the Democratic gubernatorial primary
dem_gov_results <- read_tsv(
  files,
  col_names = c(
    "county_code", "county_name", "election_id", "election_date",
    "election_name", "precinct_id", "precinct_name", "total_registered",
    "ballots_cast", "blank1", "blank2", "contest", "district",
    "contest_code", "candidate", "party", "party_num", "doe_id", "votes"
  ),
  col_types = cols(
    .default = col_character(),
    votes = col_double()
  )
) |>
  filter(contest == "Governor", party == "DEM") |>
  summarize(total_votes = sum(votes, na.rm = TRUE), .by = candidate)

winner <- dem_gov_results |>
  slice_max(total_votes, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)

ggplot(
  dem_gov_results,
  aes(x = total_votes, y = fct_reorder(candidate, total_votes))
) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 0, xend = total_votes, yend = fct_reorder(candidate, total_votes)),
    color = "#D5DCE5",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(color = total_votes), size = 4) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = scales::comma(total_votes)),
    hjust = -0.15,
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "#303846"
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    option = "C",
    end = 0.9,
    labels = scales::comma,
    name = "Total votes"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::comma,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.22))
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title = "Florida's Democratic Governor Primary",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "WINNER: ", winner$candidate[[1]], " | ",
      scales::comma(winner$total_votes[[1]]), " votes statewide"
    ),
    x = "Total votes across all 67 counties",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: Florida Department of State, precinct-level election results."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, color = "#202A36"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, color = "#355C7D"),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "#697586", hjust = 0, size = 9),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#303846"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "#596575"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#303846"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#E7E9ED", linewidth = 0.45),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(12, 36, 12, 12)
  )
```

David Jolly and Gwen Graham received the most votes, with 762,160 statewide, and won the Democratic nomination for Governor. Dayna Marie Foster placed second with 189,421 votes.
